en: Romans 16

p.src: 1  I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

ja: であるフィベを、あなたがたに
en: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
u.src: 1  I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

en: 16:1 or, deacon

p.src: 2  that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

ja: え、あなたがたの助けを
とすることがあれば、何でも
en: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
u.src: 2  that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

p.src: 3  Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

ja: キリスト・イエスにあって
であるプリスカとアキラに、よろしく
en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
u.src: 3  Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

p.src: 4  who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

ja: すほどの危険を冒してくれました。二人に
en: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
u.src: 4  who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

p.src: 5  Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

ja: するエパイネトにも、よろしく伝えてください。
はアカイアでキリストに献げられた
en: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
u.src: 5  Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

p.src: 6  Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

ja: 私たちのために大いに
したマリアに、よろしく
en: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
u.src: 6  Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

p.src: 7  Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

ja: されたアンドロニコとユニアに、よろしく
en: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
u.src: 7  Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

ja: 16:7 または「使徒たちによく知られており」

p.src: 8  Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

ja: するアンプリアスに、よろしく
en: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
u.src: 8  Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

p.src: 9  Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

ja: するスタキスに、よろしく
en: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
u.src: 9  Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

p.src: 10  Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

ja: められているアペレスに、よろしく
えてください。アリストブロの
en: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
u.src: 10  Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

p.src: 11  Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

ja: ヘロディオンに、よろしく
えてください。ナルキソの
en: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
u.src: 11  Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

p.src: 12  Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

ja: 苦しているトリファイナとトリフォサに、よろしく
するペルシスに、よろしく
en: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
u.src: 12  Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

p.src: 13  Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

ja: ばれたルフォスと、その
en: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
u.src: 13  Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

p.src: 14  Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

ja: アシンクリト、フレゴン、ヘルメス、パトロバ、ヘルマス、および
en: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
u.src: 14  Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

ja: 16:14 ここや、文脈上可能な箇所で「兄弟たち」と訳された言葉は、「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだいたち」と訳すこともできる。
en: 16:14 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 15  Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

ja: フィロロゴとユリア、ネレウスとその
らと共にいるすべての
en: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
u.src: 15  Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

p.src: 16  Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

ja: いにあいさつを交わしなさい。キリストの諸
からも、あなたがたによろしくとのあいさつがあります。
en: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
u.src: 16  Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

p.src: 17  Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

ja: たち、お願いします。あなたがたが
en: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
u.src: 17  Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

p.src: 18  For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

ja: イエス・キリストではなく、
えています。そして、なめらかな
en: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
u.src: 18  For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

p.src: 19  For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

ja: られています。ですから、私はあなたがたのことを
んでいます。しかし、あなたがたには
であってほしいのです。
en: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
u.src: 19  For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

p.src: 20  And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

ja: は、間もなくサタンをあなたがたの
かれます。 私たちの
en: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
u.src: 20  And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

p.src: 21  Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

ja: 族ルキオ、ヤソン、ソシパテロが、あなたがたによろしくと
en: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
u.src: 21  Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

p.src: 22  I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

ja: にあってあなたがたによろしくと
en: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
u.src: 22  I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

p.src: 23  Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

ja: をもてなしてくれているガイオが、あなたがたによろしくと
っています。市の会計官エラストと、兄弟クアルトも、あなたがたによろしくと言っています。
en: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
u.src: 23  Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

p.src: 24  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

ja: 私たちの主イエス・キリストの恵みが、あなたがたすべてと共にありますように。アーメン。
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
u.src: 24  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

ja: 16:25 TRは、ローマ人への手紙14:24-26を14章の終わりではなく、ローマ人への手紙の末尾に16:25-27として置いている。
en: 16:25 TR places Romans 14:24-26 at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter 14, and numbers these verses 16:25-27.
